svg.title: Figure 1: ChessFM SFT Ablation Ladder — LoRA r=64 vs Full Fine-Tuning
svg.text: Piece-List Coordinates + All-Linear LoRA r=64 Sweep Full Fine-Tuning
Frozen 0%-leakage benchmarks comparing Qwen3-4B SFT ladder (E0 -> E2b) against zero-shot Gemma-4-26B.
Piece-List + 10x LR tripled strict legality at 2.5K rows (21.0% -> 63.5%).
Dashed bar: Gemma-4-26B lenient SAN rescue (10.8%); 666/900 hit 512-tok cap.
E2a beats Full-FT by +14.0 pp and zero-shot 26B by +18.9 pp (English 90.0%, 0% leak).
D. Strict ACPL — Centipawn Loss (Legal Moves)
Source: ChessFM Phase I–II frozen 0%-leakage eval manifests (test_fens_1000, test_puzzles_900, test_chessqa_1000).
